blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Medical image segmentation (MIS) remains challenging due to composite degradations and multi-scale geometric variations, which jointly impair lesion-background separability, structural consistency, and optimization stability. Existing single-stream frameworks entangle heterogeneous cues within a single representation pathway, while hybrid-stream approaches often rely on generic or static fusion, limiting effective coordination across domains and failing to explicitly address optimization instability. To overcome these limitations, we propose a new optimization-aware dual-domain framework for MIS (O2D-MedNet). First, a degradation-aware dualdomain interaction (DDI) module integrates Fourier - and Wavelet-domain features to suppress degradation-sensitive responses while preserving structural and fine-detail information. Second, a cross-backbone contour-guided fusion (CGF) module enables selective interaction between CNN-based local detail modeling and visual state-space-based global structure modeling, improving boundary accuracy and representation consistency. Third, a gradient-context optimization (GCO) strategy stabilizes training by adaptively adjusting learning dynamics based on loss trends and gradient statistics, mitigating instability caused by class imbalance and heterogeneous sample difficulty. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art MIS methods across multiple imaging modalities. Further analyses confirm enhanced sensitivity, structural consistency, and optimization stability, validating the effectiveness of the proposed O2D-MedNet for robust MIS under heterogeneous conditions.
blocks.zh: 医疗图像分解(MIS)仍然具有挑战性,因为综合退化和多尺度几何变异共同损害损害背景分解性、结构一致性和优化稳定性。 现有的单一流程框架将不同的提示缠入单一的表述途径中,而混合流程方法往往依赖于通用或静态聚变,限制了各领域之间的有效协调,未能明确解决优化不稳定问题。 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议为管理信息系统(O2D-MedNet)建立一个新的优化-认识双重领域框架。 首先,一个具有降解意识的双域相互作用模块融合了Fourier - and Wavelet - domain 特性,以抑制对降解敏感的反应,同时保留结构和细节信息。 其次,一个跨后骨轮廓制导聚变(CGF)模块能够使基于CNN的本地细节建模和基于视觉状态-空间的全球结构建模进行选择性互动,提高边界准确度和表示一致性. 第三,梯度-背景优化(GCO)战略通过根据损失趋势和梯度统计对学习动态进行适应性调整来稳定培训,减轻由班级失衡和不同抽样困难造成的不稳定。 对6个基准的广泛试验表明,在多种成像模式中,与最先进的管理信息系统方法相比,不断改进。 进一步的分析证实提高了敏感性、结构一致性并优化了稳定性,验证了拟议的O2D-MedNet在各种条件下对强有力的管理信息系统的有效性。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Medical image segmentation (MIS) [ 1 , 2 ] is a fundamental task in medical image analysis, aiming to assign semantic labels to pixels or voxels for accurate delineation of lesions or anatomical structures. Robust MIS supports a wide range of clinical applications [ 3 , 4 ] , including disease screening , diagnosis , treatment planning , and longitudinal assessment .
However, the increasing volume and diversity of medical imaging data ( i.e. , optical , radiological , and ultrasound images) continue to impose substantial demands on clinical workflows, where manual inspection remains time-consuming and error-prone. Consequently, developing robust and scalable MIS frameworks has become increasingly important for enabling reliable clinical deployment.
blocks.zh:
医学图像分解(MIS)[1,2]是医学图像分析中的一项基本任务,旨在为像素或活体分配语义标签,以准确划分损伤或解剖结构. 强有力的管理信息系统支持广泛的临床应用[3,4],包括疾病筛查、诊断、治疗规划和纵向评估。
然而,医学成像数据(即光学、放射和超声波图像)的量和多样性不断增长,继续对临床工作流程提出大量要求,因为人工检查仍然耗费时间,容易出错。 因此,发展强有力和可扩展的管理信息系统框架对于进行可靠的临床部署已变得日益重要。

blocks.en: Despite recent advances, achieving robust MIS performance across multiple organs and imaging conditions remains challenging [ 5 ] . Specifically, medical images often exhibit composite degradations ( e.g. , noise , artifacts , and specular reflections ) together with multi-scale geometric variability in lesion and anatomical structure size , shape , and location . These factors can jointly degrade lesion–background separability, disrupt structural consistency, and lead to unstable optimization during model training. As a result, MIS approaches often struggle to simultaneously preserve fine-grained boundaries, maintain global coherence, and generalize across heterogeneous imaging samples.
blocks.zh: 尽管最近取得了进展,在多个器官和成像条件下实现强有力的管理信息系统绩效仍然具有挑战性[5]。 具体地说,医疗图像往往呈现出复合降解(如噪音、文物和光谱反射),以及损伤和解剖结构大小、形状和位置的多尺度几何可变性。 这些因素可以共同降解损伤-背景分离性,破坏结构一致性,并导致模型训练期间不稳定的优化. 因此,管理信息系统的处理方法往往难以同时保护精细的界限,保持全球一致性,并在各种成像样本中加以概括。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Comparison of representative medical image segmentation (MIS) paradigms. (a) Single-stream frameworks process either original or domain-based inputs through a single pathway, limiting their ability to disentangle heterogeneous cues [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] . (b) Hybrid-stream frameworks introduce multiple backbone branches and fuse their features to exploit complementary representations, but the interaction is typically generic or static [ 9 , 10 ] . (c) In contrast, O2D-MedNet integrates dual-domain refinement, explicit local–global decoupling, contour-guided selective fusion, and optimization-aware learning in a unified framework.
blocks.zh: 发相. 1:具有代表性的医学影像分化(MIS)范式比较. (a) 单一流程框架通过单一途径处理原始投入或基于域的投入,限制其分解不同提示[6、7、8]的能力。 (b) 混合流框架引入了多个骨干分支,并调整其特征,以利用互补的表述,但互动通常是通用的或静止的[9,10]。 (c) 相比之下,O2D-MedNet将双重领域改进、明确的本地-全球脱钩、轮廓制导的选择性聚变和在统一框架内的优化-认知学习结合起来。

blocks.en:
Existing MIS methods can be broadly categorized into single-stream and hybrid-stream frameworks, as illustrated in Figs. 1 (a) and (b). Single-stream approaches rely on a dominant representation pathway for feature extraction and prediction. Representative CNN-based models [ 6 , 11 ] are effective at capturing local textures and boundary details, whereas Transformer- and state-space-based architectures [ 7 , 12 ] improve long-range dependency modeling and global structure aggregation. Some studies further incorporate frequency-domain priors [ 13 , 8 ] to enhance robustness against image degradations.
Hybrid-stream frameworks extend this idea by introducing multiple representation pathways, such as CNN-Transformer combinations [ 9 , 10 ] , frequency-decomposition architectures [ 14 ] , and task-specific auxiliary streams [ 1 , 15 ] . Although these methods improve representation diversity, they generally rely on static feature fusion strategies or heuristic interactions, limiting their ability to adapt to local details, global structures, and degradation-sensitive responses under complex conditions.
blocks.zh:
如图1(a)和(b)所示,现有的管理信息系统方法可大致分为单一流和混合流框架。 单流方法依靠主导代表路径进行地物提取和预测。 基于CNN的代表性模型[6,11]在捕捉出当地纹理和边界细节方面是有效的,而"变形器"和"以国家为航天"的架构[7,12]则能改善远程依赖性模型和全球结构的聚合. 一些研究进一步将频域前传[13,8]纳入其中,以增强抗图像退化的强度.
混合流框架通过引入多条表达路径来扩展这一理念,如CNN-Transformer组合 [9,10],频率分解架构 [14],以及任务特定辅助流 [1,15]. 虽然这些方法改善了代表性多样性,但它们一般依靠静态特征聚变战略或热力相互作用,限制了它们适应当地细节、全球结构以及在复杂条件下对退化敏感的反应的能力。

blocks.zh:
表格 一:代表性医疗图像分解框架的分类和比较。
现有方法按其主导代表性和流式结构分类,重点是地方-全球建模、域知识、跨流互动、退化建模和优化意识。

blocks.en: We argue that a fundamental limitation of existing MIS frameworks lies in the coupled treatment of degradation suppression, representation learning, and optimization. In most existing MIS approaches, these factors are implicitly handled within a unified learning process, making it difficult to dynamically balance feature restoration, local-global representation coordination, and optimization stability. Consequently, MIS performance often deteriorates in the presence of composite degradations, large anatomical variations, class imbalance, and heterogeneous sample difficulty.
blocks.zh: 我们争辩说,现有管理信息系统框架的根本局限性在于同时处理抑制退化、代表性学习和优化。 在大多数现有的管理信息系统办法中,这些因素都隐含地在一个统一的学习进程中处理,因此难以动态地平衡特征恢复、地方-全球代表协调以及优化稳定性。 因此,在出现综合退化、大解剖变异、类别不平衡和不同样本困难的情况下,管理信息系统的性能往往会恶化。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we introduce a new o ptimization-aware d ual- d omain framework for MIS ( O2D-MedNet ). The proposed method follows a progressive design principle that explicitly decouples degradation suppression, representation learning, and optimization dynamics. First, a dual-domain interaction module exploits complementary Fourier - and Wavelet -domain information to enhance feature discriminability. Second, a contour-guided cross-backbone fusion mechanism facilitates selective integration of local and global representations, mitigating redundant and noisy feature propagation. Third, a gradient-context-aware optimization strategy dynamically adapts learning behavior according to loss trends and gradient statistics, improving optimization stability under heterogeneous data conditions. Extensive experiments on six benchmark segmentation datasets spanning three medical imaging categories as well as diverse lesions and anatomical structures demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of the proposed MIS framework.
blocks.zh: 为了应付这些挑战,我们为管理信息系统引入了一个新的激励-认识-实际-主要框架(O2D-MedNet)。 拟议方法遵循一项渐进式设计原则,明确消除退化抑制、表现学习和优化动态。 首先,一个双域互动模块利用互补的Fourier-和Wavelet-域信息来增强特征歧视. 第二,由轮廓制导的交叉背骨聚变机制有助于有选择地整合地方和全球代表,减少多余和吵闹的特征传播。 第三,梯度-背景-认识优化策略根据损失趋势和梯度统计动态地调整学习行为,在多相异的数据条件下提高优化稳定性. 对涵盖三个医学成像类别以及各种损伤和解剖结构的6个基准分解数据集进行的广泛实验,表明拟议的管理信息系统框架的有效性和普遍性。

blocks.en: The main contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose O2D-MedNet , an optimization-aware dual-domain cross-backbone interaction framework that explicitly decouples degradation suppression, representation learning, and training dynamics, enabling robust MIS under composite degradations and multi-scale anatomical variations. • We introduce a degradation-aware dual-domain interaction (DDI) mechanism that exploits complementary Fourier - and Wavelet -domain representations to improve lesion–background separability while preserving both structural integrity and fine-grained details. • We design a cross-backbone contour-guided fusion (CGF) module that adaptively integrates CNN-based local features with state-space-based global representations, enhancing structural consistency across complex anatomical morphologies and scale variations. • We develop a stable gradient-context optimization (GCO) strategy that modulates optimization behavior according to loss dynamics and gradient statistics, improving optimization stability and training robustness under class imbalance and heterogeneous sample difficulty.
blocks.zh: 主要贡献概述如下: 我们提出O2D-MedNet,这是一个最优化的双领域跨后骨互动框架,明确消除退化抑制、代表性学习和培训动态,使综合退化和多尺度解剖变化下的强性管理信息系统成为可能。 我们采用了一种具有降解意识的双重领域互动机制,利用互补的Fourier-和Wavelet-域代表,改善损害的后地分解性,同时保留结构完整性和精细细节。 我们设计了一个跨后骨轮廓制导聚变模块,以适应性的方式将基于CNN的本地特征与基于国家的空间的全球表示相融合,加强复杂解剖形态和尺度变化的结构一致性。 我们制定稳定的梯度-文本优化(GCO)策略,根据损失动态和梯度统计来调节优化行为,提高优化稳定性,在班级失衡和不同样本难度下培养稳健性.

blocks.zh: 我们提出O2D-MedNet,这是一个最优化的双领域跨后骨互动框架,明确消除退化抑制、代表性学习和培训动态,从而能够在综合退化和多尺度解剖变化下实现强有力的管理信息系统。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: MIS has been widely studied, with recent advances largely driven by deep neural networks. From the perspective of network architecture, existing MIS methods can be broadly categorized into reference baselines , single-stream frameworks , and hybrid-stream frameworks , as summarized in Table I .
blocks.zh: 管理信息系统得到了广泛的研究,最近的进展主要是由深神经网络驱动的。 从网络结构的角度来看,现有的管理信息系统方法可大致分为参考基线、单流框架和混合流框架,见表一。

blocks.en: II-A Reference Baselines
blocks.zh: 参考基线

blocks.en: We first review several representative reference baselines that provide distinct architectural paradigms for image segmentation. DeepLabv3+ [ 16 ] integrates atrous spatial pyramid pooling with an encoder–decoder architecture to capture multi-scale contextual information and progressively refine object boundaries. U 2 -Net [ 17 ] adopts a nested U-shaped architecture composed of residual U-blocks, enabling the joint modeling of fine-grained local details and multi-scale contextual features. In contrast, MedSAM [ 18 ] exemplifies the promptable medical foundation-model paradigm. It employs a ViT-based image encoder to extract image representations and a prompt encoder to embed input prompts, which are subsequently integrated by the mask decoder to generate segmentation masks. These methods represent three complementary architectural paradigms, ranging from conventional encoder-decoder networks and nested multi-scale architectures to prompt-conditioned foundation MIS models.
blocks.zh: 我们首先审查若干具有代表性的参考基线,这些基准为图像分解提供了独特的建筑范式。 DeepLabv3+ [16] 将原子空间金字塔集合与编码器-解码器架构相融合,以获取多尺度的上下文信息并逐步完善对象边界. U 2-Net [17] 采用了由残存的U-块组成的嵌入式U-形状建筑,使得能联合建模精细的局部细节和多尺度上下文特征. 相形之下,MedSAM [18] 体现了迅速的医学基础-模型范式. 它使用一个基于ViT的图像编码器来提取图像表示和一个即时编码器来嵌入输入提示,这些提示器随后被口罩解码器集成以生成分解口罩. 这些方法代表了三种互补的建筑范式,从传统的编码器-解码器网络和嵌入式多尺度建筑到快速有条件的基础MIS模型.

blocks.en: II-B Single-stream Frameworks
blocks.zh: 二-B 单一流程框架

blocks.en: Single-stream MIS frameworks [ 29 , 30 , 31 ] rely on a dominant network pathway, where feature extraction, context aggregation, and prediction are conducted on a single backbone architecture, including U-shaped - or CNN -based, Transformer -based, visual state-space model (VSSM)-based, and other domain -based models.
blocks.zh: 单流管理信息系统框架[29、30、31]依赖于一个主导网络路径,其中特征提取、上下文汇总和预测是在单一主干结构上进行的,包括基于U-形状的 -- -- 或CNN、基于变形器的可视状态空间模型(VSSM)以及其他基于域的模型。

blocks.en: U-shaped or CNN -based. Early MIS methods are primarily based on U-shaped encoder–decoder or CNN-based networks, where hierarchical convolutional features are progressively encoded and decoded for dense prediction [ 32 , 33 ] . Representative models, such as ACNN [ 19 ] , DRINet [ 20 ] , BCDU-Net [ 21 ] , CyCoSeg [ 6 ] , FusionNet [ 34 ] , UNeXt [ 35 ] , MBP-SSNet [ 36 ] , and EAG-SAE-ESTF [ 11 ] , enhance this paradigm through improved skip connections, contextual modeling, and feature refinement. These methods are effective at capturing local textures and boundary details, which are essential for segmenting small lesions and thin anatomical structures. However, their convolution-dominant design inherently relies on local receptive fields, making it difficult to model long-range dependencies and maintain global structural coherence when anatomical variations are large or spatially dispersed.
blocks.zh: U形或CNN - 基于. 早期的MIS方法主要基于U形的编码器-解码器或基于CNN的网络,在这些网络中,分级的演化特征被逐渐地编码并解码来进行密集的预测[32,33]. 具有代表性的模型,如ACNN [19],DRINet [20],BCDU-Net [21],CyCoSeg [6],FusionNet [34],UNeXt [35],MBP-SSNet [36],以及EAG-SAE-ESTF [11],通过改进跳过连接,上下文建模,并改进特征来强化这一范式. 这些方法对于捕捉局部纹理和边界细节是有效的,对于分解小损伤和薄解剖结构至关重要. 然而,它们的分化主导设计本质上依赖于当地的可接受领域,使得在解剖学变异较大或空间分散时难以对长距离依赖性进行建模并保持全球结构一致性.

blocks.en: Transformer -based. To address the above limitation, Transformer-based single-stream MIS models introduce self-attention mechanisms to enhance global structure modeling. For instance, Swin-UNet [ 22 ] , MISSFormer [ 7 ] , LeViT-UNet [ 37 ] , FAT-Net [ 12 ] , and CSWin-UNet [ 38 ] capture long-range dependencies through various attention designs. More recently, SAM2-UNet [ 27 ] integrates the Hiera backbone of SAM2 with a U-shaped decoder and lightweight adapters for prompt-free segmentation, retaining a dominant single-stream pathway. While these approaches improve the representation of large-scale structures, they still operate within a single pathway, where local detail preservation and global structure modeling are tightly coupled. This coupling makes it difficult to adaptively prioritize boundary-sensitive cues or global semantics under varying imaging conditions. Especially, global aggregation may smooth fine structures or weaken subtle lesion boundaries in low-contrast or noisy regions.
blocks.zh: 变形器 - 基于. 为了解决上述限制,基于变形器的单流管理信息系统模型引入了自我关注机制,以加强全球结构模型。 例如,Swin-UNet [22],MISSFORmer [7],LeViT-UNet [37],FAT-Net [12],和CSWin-UNet [38]通过各种关注设计捕捉到远程依赖性. 最近,SAM2-UNet [27]将SAM2的Hiera主干线与U形的解码器和轻量级适配器相融合,以进行即时无阻分解,保留了主导性单流路径. 虽然这些方法改善了大型结构的代表性,但它们仍然在一条单一的道路上运作,当地细节保存和全球结构模型的制作紧密结合。 这种耦合使得很难在不同的成像条件下适应性地优先排列边界敏感提示或全球语义. 特别是,全球聚合可能会平滑细细的结构,或削弱低相冲突或吵闹地区的细微损伤边界。

blocks.en: VSSM -based. More recently, VSSM-based architectures, such as Mamba-UNet [ 23 ] , LKM-UNet [ 24 ] , H-vmuNet [ 39 ] , UltraLight VM [ 40 ] , and Mamba-Sea [ 25 ] , provide an alternative mechanism for efficient long-range modeling. These methods improve computational efficiency while maintaining global structure awareness. However, similar to CNN- and Transformer-based MIS schemes, they still encode local details, global structures, and scale variations within a single pathway. Consequently, they continue to face an inherent trade-off between local sensitivity and global coherence, especially under composite degradations and heterogeneous anatomical variations.
blocks.zh: VSSM - 基于. 最近,基于VSSM的建筑,如Mamba-UNet [23],LKM-UNet [24],H-vmuNet [39],UltraLight VM [40],和Mamba-Sea [25],为高效的远程建模提供了替代机制. 这些方法提高了计算效率,同时保持了全球结构意识。 然而,类似于CNN和变形器的MIS计划,它们仍然在单一路径内编码本地细节、全球结构和规模变化。 因此,它们继续面临地方敏感性和全球一致性之间的内在取舍,特别是在综合退化和不同的解剖变异的情况下。

blocks.en: Domain -based. Another line of MIS work incorporates frequency-domain information to enhance robustness. For example, GobletNet [ 13 ] explores wavelet-based high-frequency, while MADGNet [ 8 ] and FFTMed [ 26 ] introduces multi-frequency of discrete cosine transform (DCT)- or Fourier -domain cues to strengthen boundary sensitivity and suppress noise. Although these approaches improve degradation robustness, they typically inject domain information into a single-stream backbone with fixed or weakly adaptive fusion strategies. Consequently, degradation suppression is not explicitly coordinated with representation learning or training dynamics, limiting their effectiveness under complex medical imaging conditions.
blocks.zh: 域名 - 基于. 管理信息系统的另一行工作包括了频率域信息,以提高稳健性。 例如,GobletNet [13] 探索以波为主的高频,而MADGNet [8]和FFTMed [26] 引入了多频离散的余弦变换(DCT)-或Fourier-域来增强边界敏感性并抑制噪音. 虽然这些方法提高了退化强度,但它们通常将域信息注入具有固定或弱适应性聚变策略的单流骨干中. 因此,对降解的抑制没有与代表性学习或培训动态明确相协调,限制了其在复杂医学成像条件下的有效性。

blocks.en: Summary . Despite their diverse network architectures, single-stream MIS methods fundamentally entangle degradation suppression, representation learning, and optimization within a unified or single pathway. This implicit coupling assumes that a single representation can simultaneously resolve degradation-induced ambiguity, capture multi-scale structural variations, or maintain stable optimization dynamics. However, such an assumption becomes weak or invalid under heterogeneous imaging conditions, where these factors impose competing and condition-dependent requirements. As a result, single-stream MIS models lack the flexibility to adaptively prioritize local detail, global structure, or robustness to degradations, leading to compromised segmentation performance.
blocks.zh: 总结. 尽管网络结构多种多样,但单流管理信息系统方法从根本上缠绕了降解抑制、表现学习和在统一或单一路径内优化。 这种隐含的耦合假设,单一代表可以同时解决退化引起的模糊性,捕捉到多尺度的结构变化,或者保持稳定的优化动态. 然而,在不同的成像条件下,这种假设变得软弱或无效,这些因素提出了相互竞争和取决于条件的要求。 因此,单流管理信息系统模型缺乏灵活性,无法适应性地确定当地细节、全球结构或退化的强性,导致分化性能受损。

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Overview of the proposed dual-domain cross-backbone interaction framework for MIS ( O2D-MedNet ). A dual-domain refinement (DDI) module integrates global spectral and local multi-resolution cues to suppress degradations and enhance feature separability. Parallel CNN and VSSM branches then capture local details and global structures, respectively. A contour-guided fusion (CGF) module enables selective cross-backbone interaction in skip connections to improve multi-scale structural consistency and reduce redundant propagation. Finally, a gradient-context optimization (GCO) strategy adapts training based on loss evolution and gradient statistics to improve optimization stability and generalization.
blocks.zh: 发相. 2: MIS(O2D-MedNet)拟议的双域交叉后骨互动框架概述。 双域改进模块整合了全球光谱和局部多分辨率提示,以抑制降解并增强特征分解性。 然后平行的CNN和VSSM分支分别捕捉到本地细节和全球结构. 轮廓制导的聚变(CGF)模块可以在跳过连接时进行有选择的交叉后骨相互作用来提高多尺度的结构一致性并减少冗余传播. 最后,梯度-背景优化(GCO)战略根据损失演化和梯度统计调整培训,以提高优化稳定性和通俗化.

blocks.en: II-C Hybrid-stream Frameworks
blocks.zh: 二-混合流框架

blocks.en: Hybrid-stream MIS frameworks [ 41 , 42 ] aim to alleviate the bottlenecks of single-stream models by introducing multiple pathways to exploit complementary information, including hybrid-backbone -based, hybrid-frequency -based, and hybrid-task -based models.
blocks.zh: 混合流管理信息系统框架[41,42]旨在通过采用多种途径利用互补信息来缓解单流模型的瓶颈,包括混合-后骨基、混合-频率基和混合-任务基模型。

blocks.en: Hybrid-backbone -based. One common MIS architecture design combines CNN-based local modeling with Transformer-style global modeling. For example, MedT [ 28 ] , TransFuse [ 9 ] , and H2Former [ 10 ] capture both fine-grained local details and long-range dependencies, demonstrating that local and global representations are inherently complementary for MIS. However, these methods implicitly assume that complementary representations can be effectively combined through static or heuristic fusion mechanisms. In addition, they also lack an explicit strategy to determine when local details should dominate and when global structures should be emphasized under varying degradation levels and boundary ambiguities. Consequently, fusion may propagate redundant or noisy features, or suppress subtle yet important structures.
blocks.zh: 混合后骨 - 基于. 一种常见的MIS架构设计将基于CNN的本地模型与变形器风格的全球模型结合. 例如,MDT [28],TransFuse [9],和H2Former [10] 既捕捉了精细的当地细节,又捕捉了长距离的依赖性,表明地方和全球代表对MIS的内在补充. 然而,这些方法隐含地假设,通过静态或休克聚变机制,可以有效地将互补的表达方式结合起来. 此外,它们也缺乏明确的战略来确定何时应该以地方细节为主,何时应该以不同的退化程度和边界模糊性来强调全球结构。 因此,聚变可能传播多余或吵闹的特征,或压制微妙而重要的结构。

blocks.en: Hybrid-frequency -based. Hybrid frequencies [ 43 , 44 ] provide another form of complementary modeling. For instance, XNet [ 14 ] separates low- and high-frequency components, processes them with dedicated encoders, and produces dual-branch segmentation predictions. While this design improves representation diversity, its complementarity is largely constrained to frequency decomposition and consistency learning. Moreover, it does not explicitly coordinate local-global backbone biases, nor does it address optimization instability during training.
blocks.zh: 混合频率 - 基于. 混合频率[43,44]提供了另一种形式的互补模型. 例如,XNet[14]将低频和高频组件分开,用专用编码器处理,并产生双分支分解预测. 虽然这种设计改进了代表性的多样性,但其互补性主要限于频率分解和一致性学习。 此外,它没有明确协调地方-全球骨干偏见,也没有解决培训期间的优化不稳定问题。

blocks.en: Hybrid-task -based. Other hybrid MIS approaches incorporate auxiliary tasks or supervision strategies [ 45 , 46 , 47 ] , such as super-resolution DS2F [ 1 ] or weak supervision MambaEviScrib [ 15 ] . These methods further highlight the benefit of multi-stream modeling under specific settings. Nevertheless, their interaction mechanisms are often task-dependent, and their optimization processes remain governed by fixed or empirically tuned schedules. Consequently, their robustness may degrade under heterogeneous imaging samples or complex degradations.
blocks.zh: 混合任务 - 基于任务. 其他混合管理信息系统方法包括辅助任务或监督战略[45、46、47],如超分辨率DS2F[1]或薄弱监督MambaEviScrib[15]。 这些方法进一步突出了在特定环境下多流模型的优点。 尽管如此,它们的互动机制往往取决于任务,其优化进程仍受固定或经验调整的时间表所制约。 因此,它们的坚固性可能在不同的成像样本或复杂的降解下降解.

blocks.en: Summary . Hybrid-stream MIS frameworks partially relax the representation bottleneck by introducing multiple pathways, yet they typically treat degradation handling, cross-stream interaction, and optimization as loosely coupled components. Their fusion strategies often rely on static or weakly adaptive mechanisms, implicitly assuming that complementary representations can be combined without considering condition-dependent dominance or degradation sensitivity. Moreover, learning optimization remains external to network architectures, limiting the ability to stabilize training. As a result, although hybrid-stream models improve representation diversity, they still lack a unified and adaptive mechanism to coordinate degradation suppression, representation interaction, and optimization dynamics under challenging conditions.
blocks.zh: 总结. 混合流管理信息系统框架引入了多种途径,从而部分地放松了表示瓶颈,但它们通常将降解处理、跨流相互作用和优化视为松散的组合部分。 它们的聚变战略往往依赖静态或弱适应机制,隐含地假设补充性表述可以合并,而不考虑取决于条件的支配地位或退化敏感性. 此外,学习优化仍然是网络架构的外在,限制了稳定培训的能力. 因此,虽然混合流模式改善了代表多样性,但它们仍然缺乏一个统一和适应的机制来协调在挑战性条件下的退化抑制、代表互动和优化动态。

blocks.en: III Methodology
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: The overall architecture of O2D-MedNet is illustrated in Fig. 2 . The framework consists of three main components: (1) a degradation-aware dual-domain interaction (DDI) module, (2) a cross-backbone contour-guided fusion (CGF) module, and (3) a stable gradient-context optimization (GCO) strategy. Given an input medical image, DDI first enhances feature discriminability through complementary Fourier - and Wavelet -domain processing. The refined features are subsequently encoded by parallel CNN and VSSM branches, where CGF enables selective fusion between local and global representations. During training, GCO dynamically adapts optimization behavior according to gradient context to improve optimization stability.
blocks.zh: 图2说明了O2D-MedNet的整体架构. 框架由三个主要部分组成:(1) 降解感知双域相互作用(DDI)模块;(2) 交叉后骨整流导聚变(CGF)模块;和(3) 稳定的梯度-文本优化(GCO)策略. 鉴于输入的医学图像,DDI首先通过互补的Fourier - 和Wavelet - domain处理来增强特征的区别性. 精细的特性随后被平行的CNN和VSSM分支所编码,CGF可以在当地和全球代表之间进行选择性的聚变. 在训练期间,GCO根据梯度上下文动态地调整优化行为,以提高优化稳定性.

blocks.en: III-A Degradation-Aware Dual-Domain Interaction
blocks.zh: 三-A 退化-意识到的双重领域相互作用

blocks.en: In MIS, composite degradations are often amplified in early feature representations, leading to ambiguous lesion–background boundaries and unstable downstream learning [ 48 ] . Since such degradation-induced responses cannot be reliably suppressed by representation learning alone, we first introduce a dual-domain refinement stage to improve feature separability before high-level modeling.

The sample-level gate and the subsequent spatial recalibration address different levels of degradation uncertainty, as shown in Fig. 3 . Meanwhile, composite degradations often vary substantially across samples: some images are dominated by specular highlights, whereas others are mainly affected by noise, artifacts, or weak contrast. Therefore, the scalar gate g b g_{b} estimates the global reliability of dual-domain responses for each sample, which is broadcast to all channel and spatial positions during fusion.
However, lesions and anatomical structures are also spatially non-uniform within the same sample. A spatial modulation step is thus required to suppress local false responses while preserving informative lesion regions. In this sense, g b g_{b} determines how much dual-domain information should be trusted globally, whereas the spatial gate refines where such information should be emphasized locally.

blocks.en: After dual-domain feature interaction, the model proceeds to representation learning through parallel CNN and VSSM branches. It is noted that CNN features are sensitive to local textures and boundary details, and VSSM features are effective for modeling long-range dependencies and global semantics. However, directly fusing these heterogeneous representations assumes feature compatibility, which is often violated under complex degradations and scale variations [ 49 ] .
blocks.zh: 双域功能互动后,模型通过平行的CNN和VSSM分支开始进行表现学习. 值得注意的是,有线电视新闻网的功能对地表纹理和边界细节很敏感,而VSSM的功能对于建模远程依赖性和全球语义是有效的. 然而,直接使这些不同表述产生相容性假设特征相容性,在复杂的降解和尺度相变[49]下,特征相容性常常被侵犯.

blocks.en: IV Experimental Validations
blocks.zh: 四. 实验验证

blocks.en:
In the experiments, we evaluate three aspects of O2D-MedNet :
(1) the robustness of MIS performance under heterogeneous degradations,
(2) the effectiveness of explicit local-global decoupling with selective cross-backbone interaction, and
(3) the impact of optimization-aware training on optimization stability.
Specifically, we have conducted comprehensive evaluations across various heterogeneous medical imaging datasets, diverse segmentation backbones, and extensive ablation settings, together with computational complexity analysis.
blocks.zh:
在实验中,我们评价O2D-MedNet的三个方面:
(1) 管理信息系统在多种降解情况下的活性强;
(2) 明确的地方-全球脱钩与有选择地交叉背骨相互作用的有效性,以及
(3)优化意识培训对优化稳定性的影响.
具体地说,我们对各种不同的医学成像数据集、不同的分块主干和广泛的衰减设置以及计算复杂性分析进行了全面评估。

blocks.en: IV-A 2 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: IV-A 2 评价计量

blocks.en: We adopt Dice similarity coefficient (DSC, Dice ) [ 61 ] , mean intersection-over-union ( mIoU ) [ 62 ] , and Sensitivity [ 63 ] to measure region overlap and foreground detection capability, which have been widely used in existing MIS frameworks [ 64 , 65 , 18 ] . In addition, Betti Error (BE) [ 66 ] is widely used to evaluate topological consistency by measuring the discrepancy between predicted and ground-truth Betti numbers. For multiclass settings, Dice and mIoU are macro-averaged over foreground classes excluding the lesion-background, and for binary settings, all metrics are computed on the foreground class.
blocks.zh: 我们采用Dice相似系数(DSC, Dice)[61],指交叉相通(mIoU)[62],并采用灵敏度[63]测量区域重叠和前地探测能力,这些在现有的管理信息系统框架[64、65、18]中得到广泛使用。 此外,贝蒂误差(BE)[66]被广泛用于通过测量预测和地-实贝蒂数之间的差异来评价地形一致性. 对于多类设置,Dice和mIoU是排除损伤-后地的前地类的宏平均值,对于二进制设置,所有度量衡都是在前地类上计算出.

blocks.en: IV-A 3 Comparison Methods
blocks.zh: 四-A 3 比较方法

blocks.en: We compare O2D-MedNet with a broad set of representative MIS approaches, following the taxonomy established in Section II . Specifically, all competing methods are grouped into three categories: (1) Reference Baselines , (2) Single-stream Frameworks , and (3) Hybrid-stream Frameworks . • Reference Baselines. We adopt six widely-used segmentation backbones and classical architectures, including U 2 -Net [ 17 ] , DeepLabV3+ [ 16 ] , SFM [ 57 ] , TherNet [ 58 ] , MWCNN [ 59 ] , and MedSAM [ 18 ] . These methods provide standardized baselines for evaluating general segmentation capability and robustness under varying imaging conditions. • Single-stream Frameworks. We consider representative CNN-based, Transformer-based, VSSM-based, and frequency-enhanced single-stream models, such as SAM2-UNet [ 27 ] , BCDU-Net [ 21 ] , MTG-Net [ 60 ] , MISSFormer [ 7 ] , Swin-UNet [ 22 ] , Mamba-UNet [ 23 ] , LKM-UNet [ 24 ] , GobletNet [ 13 ] , MADGNet [ 8 ] , and FFTMed [ 26 ] . These methods represent diverse strategies for enhancing local detail, global structure, and domain-based representations within a single network pathway. • Hybrid-stream Frameworks. We further compare with representative hybrid architectures that combine heterogeneous representations, including MedT [ 28 ] , TransFuse [ 9 ] , H2Former [ 10 ] , MambaEviScrib [ 15 ] , XNet [ 14 ] , and DS2F [ 1 ] . These methods incorporate multi-branch designs to exploit complementary local-global or multi-domain information, providing strong baselines for evaluating the effectiveness of cross-stream interaction and fusion strategies.

blocks.en: IV-A 4 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 四-A 4 执行细节

blocks.en: O2D-MedNet is implemented in PyTorch and trained on an Intel i9-10980XE CPU and an NVIDIA GeForce RTX4090 GPU. Adam is used as the base optimizer, with an initial learning rate of 1 × 10 − 3 1\times 10^{-3} and a weight decay of 1 × 10 − 2 1\times 10^{-2} . For all experiments, images are resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 and each input is converted to a three-channel representation by channel replication when necessary and normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . We adopt five-fold cross-validation for all datasets. In each round, one fold is used for testing and the remaining four folds are used for training. The related network is optimized using the binary cross-entropy with logits loss ( i.e. , BCEWithLogits loss), while the learning rate schedule is adaptively controlled by our GCO module. Finally, training is conducted for 500 epochs with a batch size of 4.

blocks.en: IV-B 1 Quantitative Comparison

blocks.en: Table II reports the quantitative results on six MIS dataset benchmarks. For clarity, competing methods are grouped into Reference Baselines , Single-stream Frameworks , Hybrid-stream Frameworks , and our O2D-MedNet . As seen, O2D-MedNet consistently achieves the best performance across all datasets, yielding the highest mIoU and Dice values. This uniform dominance across heterogeneous imaging modalities indicates strong robustness to variations in degradation patterns, target scale, and anatomical complexity.
blocks.zh: 表二报告了6个管理信息系统数据集基准的量化结果。 为明确起见,相互竞争的方法分为参考基线、单一流框架、混合流框架和我们的O2D-MedNet。 如所见,O2D-MedNet在所有数据集中一贯实现最佳性能,得出了最高的mIoU和Dice值. 不同成像模式的这种统一主导地位表明,退化模式、目标规模和解剖复杂性的变化具有强烈的强烈性。

blocks.en: Compared with the highest-competing method in Table II on each dataset, O2D-MedNet improves mIoU/Dice by 5.0/3.8 on Oral , 3.4/2.0 on Kvasir-SEG , 3.2/1.9 on COVID-19 , 3.8/2.8 on MLUA , 0.5/0.2 on CT2US , and 2.2/2.9 on BUSI . Notably, the gains are more significant on datasets with small or sparse targets, ambiguous boundaries, and severe degradations ( e.g. , Oral , BUSI , and MLUA ), while remaining consistent on CT2US . In addition, O2D-MedNet often achieves lower or comparable standard deviations, suggesting greater robustness rather than optimization for specific data splits.

blocks.en: Fig. 6 presents qualitative comparisons across different image modalities. To ensure representative coverage, we select two Reference Baselines ( U 2 -Net and DeepLabV3+ ), five Single-stream Frameworks ( LeViT-UNet , FAT-Net , LKM-UNet , H-vmuNet , and GobletNet ), and three Hybrid-stream Frameworks ( XNet , H2Former , and DS2F ). Overall, O2D-MedNet produces predictions that are more consistent with ground truth (GT), with cleaner boundaries, fewer false positives, and reduced missed regions.
blocks.zh: 图6提供了不同图像模式的定性比较。 为确保具有代表性,我们选择了两个参考基线(U 2-Net和DeepLabV3+),五个单一流框架(LeViT-UNet、FAT-Net、LKM-UNet、H-vmuNet和GobletNet),以及三个混合流框架(XNet、H2Former和DS2F)。 总体而言,O2D-MedNet生成的预测更符合地上真理(GT),边界更干净,假阳性减少,错失区域减少.

blocks.en: For optical RGB images, MIS methods are often affected by illumination variations and specular reflections, whereas O2D-MedNet suppresses such degradations and improves lesion-background separation. For radiological images, it maintains both global coherence and local detail, reducing fragmentation and omission. For ultrasound images, it produces more continuous boundaries under speckle noise. Benefiting from dual-domain refinement, local-global decoupling, and contour-guided selective interaction, O2D-MedNet better preserves both regional coherence and fine lesion delineation across various modalities.
blocks.zh: 对于光学RGB图像来说,MIS方法往往会受发光变异和光谱反射的影响,而O2D-MedNet则会抑制这种降解并改进损伤-后地分离. 就放射性图像而言,它既保持全球一致性,又保持局部细节,减少了零散和遗漏。 对于超声波图像,它会在光谱噪声下产生更连续的边界. O2D-MedNet从双重领域改进、地方-全球脱钩和轮廓指导的选择性互动中受益,更好地维护了各区域的一致性和各种模式的细微损害。

blocks.en: TABLE III: Ablation study on the Oral and COVID-19 datasets. Higher values indicate better performance for mIoU , Dice , and Sensitivity (‘Sens.’), while lower values indicate better performance for Betti Error (BE).
blocks.zh: 表三:关于口服和COVID-19数据集的研究。 较高的数值表示mIoU,Dice,和灵敏度("sens.")性能较好,而较低的数值表示贝蒂错误(BE)性能较好.

blocks.en: IV-C Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: IV-C 读取研究

blocks.en: IV-C 1 Quantitative Analysis
blocks.zh: IV-C 1 定量分析

blocks.en: Table III presents component-wise ablation results on Oral and COVID-19 . The ablation pipeline follows the construction of O2D-MedNet , starting from a CNN baseline and progressively adding the VSSM branch, CGF, DDI, and GCO. As the model is extended from setting 1 to setting 5 , mIoU and Dice results consistently improve, along with significant reductions in BE. This indicates that the proposed components improve not only overlap accuracy but also structural and topological consistency.
blocks.zh: 表三按构成部分列出口服和COVID-19的结果。 从CNN基线开始建造了O2D-MedNet,并逐步增加了VSSM分支、CGF、DDI和GCO。 随着模式从设定1扩展至设定5,mIoU和Dice结果不断改善,BE也大幅削减. 这表明,拟议组成部分不仅提高了重叠的准确性,而且提高了结构和地形的一致性。

blocks.en: Introducing the VSSM branch reduces the BE results from 13.0 to 10.3 on Oral and from 15.8 to 11.4 on COVID-19 , showing that long-range dependency modeling improves global structural coherence. However, it slightly reduces sensitivity from 92.3 to 91.1 on Oral , suggesting that global modeling alone is insufficient for stable detection of subtle lesions.
blocks.zh: 采用VSSM分支将BE结果从口服的13.0分减为10.3%;COVID-19的15.8分减为11.4%分,表明远程依赖性模型可改善全球结构的一致性。 不过,它略微降低了口服92.3至91.1的敏感性,说明单靠全球模型不足以稳定地检测出微妙的损伤。

blocks.en: After incorporating CGF, BE further decreases to 7.9, while sensitivity recovers to 93.3 on Oral , validating its role in coordinating local and global features. Adding DDI yields substantial gains, especially on COVID-19 , where Dice increases from 88.9 to 90.1 and BE decreases from 8.8 to 5.8. This is consistent with its role in suppressing degradation-sensitive responses on composite distortions. Finally, GCO further reduces BE from 5.3 to 3.4 on Oral , and it also improves the sensitivity from 93.2 to 95.5. These results indicate that GCO mainly contributes by alleviating under-convergence and training oscillation, thereby improving recall and structural stability.
blocks.zh: 在纳入CGF后,将进一步减少到7.9,而敏感性则恢复到93.3口服,从而证明它在协调地方和全球特点方面的作用。 增加DDI可产生很大收益,特别是在COVID-19方面,Dice从88.9增加到90.1,BE从8.8减少到5.8。 这与其在抑制对退化敏感的综合扭曲反应方面的作用是一致的。 最后,GCO进一步将口服BE从5.3降至3.4,还将灵敏度从93.2提高到95.5. 这些结果表明,GCO主要通过缓解不一致和培训振荡,从而改善召回和结构稳定性来做出贡献.

blocks.en: Fig. 7: Qualitative ablation results on representative samples from Oral and COVID-19 datasets. The predictions show progressively improved completeness and structural consistency.
blocks.zh: 发相. 7: 口服和COVID-19数据集的代表性样本的定性衰减结果。 这些预测表明,完整性和结构一致性正在逐步提高。

blocks.en: IV-C 2 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: IV-C 2 定性分析

blocks.en: Fig. 7 presents qualitative results that are consistent with the quantitative trends in Table III . In the CNN-only setting 1 , the predictions exhibit scattered activations and fragmented lesion regions, particularly in the oral lesion cases and the CT case. Incorporating the VSSM branch in setting 2 improves spatial coherence, although boundary delineation remains coarse and some lesion regions are still misaligned with the GT results.
blocks.zh: 图7列出了与表三所列数量趋势相一致的质量结果。 在只有CNN的设定1中,预测显示出零散的激活和零散的损伤区域,特别是在口腔损伤病例和CT病例中。 将VSSM分支纳入设定2可以提高空间一致性,尽管边界划定仍然粗糙,一些损害区域仍然与GT结果不符。

blocks.en:
With CGF in the setting 3 , lesion-background interfaces become more stable, and spurious connectivity or hole-like errors are reduced, indicating more effective local-global decoupling.
Adding DDI in setting 4 suppresses spurious activations and produces cleaner responses around lesion boundaries. The full O2D-MedNet in setting 5 yields the most balanced predictions, preserving lesion structures while reducing lesion-background interference, resulting in more compact and accurate segmentation results across both oral and CT cases.
blocks.zh:
随着CGF在设置 3 中,损伤后地界面变得更加稳定,虚构的连通性或类似洞的错误被减少,表明更有效的局部-全球脱钩.
在设定 4 抑制假活化时添加 DDI ,并在损伤边界周围产生更清洁的反应. 完整的O2D-MedNet在设定5时产生最平衡的预测,保留了损伤结构并减少了损伤后地干扰,从而在口腔和CT病例中产生更紧凑更准确的分解结果.

blocks.en: IV-D Effectiveness Analysis
blocks.zh: 四. 有效性分析

blocks.en: Although the ablation study quantifies the contribution of each component, it does not fully explain the underlying mechanisms. Therefore, we further analyze the effectiveness of the key modules ( i.e. , DDI, CGF, and GCO) from the perspectives of input-feature separability, cross-backbone interaction, and optimization dynamics.
blocks.zh: 虽然衰减研究对每个组成部分的贡献进行了量化,但它没有充分解释基本机制。 因此,我们从输入特性分离、交叉后骨相互作用和优化动态的角度,进一步分析关键模块(即DDI、CGF和GCO)的有效性。

blocks.en: Fig. 8: Effectiveness of DDI. Comparison of local ROIs before and after DDI, along with Sobel gradient distributions and scanline intensity profiles. DDI suppresses spurious high-frequency responses while preserving true boundary structures, thereby improving lesion-background separability.
blocks.zh: 发相. 8: DDI的有效性. DDI前后本地ROI的比较,以及索贝尔梯度分布和扫描线强度配置. DDI抑制了虚假的高频响应,同时保留了真实的边界结构,从而改善了损伤-后地分解性.

blocks.en: IV-D 1 DDI Module
blocks.zh: IV-D 1 DDI 模块

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 8 , DDI modifies the local response distribution within the lesion-centered regions of interest (ROI). Compared with the response before DDI (top-left), the response after DDI exhibits reduced activation intensity in surrounding regions while preserving the main lesion contour. This effect is further reflected in the intensity profile along the sampled horizontal line (bottom), where the response becomes smoother and local fluctuations are noticeably attenuated.
blocks.zh: 如图8所示,DDI修改了以损伤为中心感兴趣区域内的局部反应分布。 与DDI(左上方)前的反应相比,DDI后的反应在保持主要损伤轮廓的同时会降低周边区域的活化强度. 这种影响进一步反映在所取取取的横向线(下行)的强度图中,反应变得更平滑,局部起伏明显减弱.

blocks.en: The corresponding Sobel gradient distributions (top-right) show improved separation between the lesion boundary band and the surrounding lesion-background ring after DDI, accompanied by consistent increases in Area-Under-the-Curve (AUC) and Contrast-to-Noise Ratio (CNR). These results indicate that DDI suppresses degradation-sensitive and background-related responses while preserving boundary-relevant structures, leading to improved lesion-background separability and a more reliable feature representation for subsequent segmentation.
blocks.zh: 相应的索贝尔梯度分布(上-右)显示,在DDI后,损害边界带和周围损害-后地环之间的分化有所改善,同时,Curve下区(AUC)和Contrast-to-Noise比(CNR)也持续增加. 这些结果表明,DDI抑制了对退化问题敏感和与背景相关的反应,同时保留了与边界有关的结构,从而改善了损害背景的可分性,并为以后的分解提供了更可靠的特征说明。

blocks.en: Fig. 9: Effectiveness of CGF. Comparison with DFM , CRIMs , CRFM , and CGAF on Oral and COVID-19 . CGF achieves the best performance in both overlap accuracy and topological consistency.
blocks.zh: 图9:全球治理论坛的有效性。 与DFM、CRIMs、CRM和CGAF关于口服和COVID-19的比较。 CGF在重叠准确性和地貌一致性方面都取得了最佳的性能.

blocks.en: IV-D 2 CGF Module
blocks.zh: 四-D 2 CGF单元

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 9 , CGF is compared with several representative fusion modules, including DFM [ 67 ] , CRIMs [ 68 ] , CRFM [ 69 ] , and CGAF [ 70 ] .
Specifically, DFM performs pixel-wise adaptive fusion by concatenating two-branch features, CRIMs uses channel-resolution cross-attention to exchange information between high-resolution location features and high-channel shape features, CRFM conducts cross-resolution feature interaction to align and fuse features with different spatial granularities, and CGAF adopts content-guided attention to estimate spatial mixing weights and combines low- and high-level features.
CGF consistently achieves the best overall performance. On the Oral dataset, it achieves the highest Dice (96.8), Sensitivity (95.5), and mIoU (91.9), while achieving the lowest Betti Error (3.4). Similar trends are observed on the COVID-19 dataset, where CGF obtains the highest Dice (90.4), Sensitivity (89.9), and mIoU (82.6), together with the lowest Betti Error (4.0).
blocks.zh:
如图9所示,CGF与几个有代表性的聚变模块进行了比较,包括DFM [67],CRIMs [68],CRM [69],和CGAF [70].
具体来说,DFM通过调取两分支特征来进行像素相适应的聚变,CRIMs使用通道分辨率交叉意向在高分辨率位置特征和高通道外形特征之间交换信息,CRFM进行跨分辨率特征交互,使不同空间颗粒的特征对接并引信,CGAF采用内容引导的注意力来估计空间相混合的重量并结合低等和高等特征.
CGF一贯取得最佳的整体业绩. 在口服数据集上,它实现了最高的Dice(96.8),灵敏度(95.5)和mIoU(91.9),同时实现了最低的Betti Error(3.4). 在COVID-19数据集上也观察到了类似趋势,CGF获得最高的Dice(90.4),灵敏度(89.9)和mIoU(82.6)以及最低的Betti Error(4.0.

blocks.en: The consistent improvements across both overlap- and topology-related metrics indicate that CGF effectively enhances cross-backbone feature integration. By combining contour-guided selective interaction with local-consistency modulation, CGF better coordinates CNN-based local details and VSSM-based global structure, resulting in improved robust MIS performance.
blocks.zh: 与重叠和地貌有关的衡量标准方面的持续改进表明,气候基金有效地加强了交叉后骨特征的整合。 通过将轮廓制导的选择性互动与局部一致性调制相结合,CGF更好地协调了基于CNN的本地细节和基于VSSM的全球结构,从而改进了强大的MIS性能.

blocks.en: Fig. 10: Effectiveness of GCO. Prediction evolution across training epochs on representative samples from Oral and COVID-19 datasets.
blocks.zh: 发相. 10: GCO的有效性. 口服和COVID-19数据集代表性样本的培训历程预测演变。

blocks.en: IV-D 3 GCO Module
blocks.zh: 四-D 3 GCO模块

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 10 , we visualize prediction evolution at 100, 200, 300, 400, and 500 epochs for representative Oral and COVID-19 samples. Without GCO, the predictions exhibit noticeable instability across training epochs, characterized by fluctuations in lesion size and spatial localization. For the Oral sample, lesion responses emerge at early epochs but progressively shrink from 300 to 500 epochs. Similarly, the COVID-19 sample shows irregular variations in both lesion extent and spatial distribution throughout training.
blocks.zh: 如图10所示,我们对具有代表性的口腔和COVID-19样本的预测演化过程进行了可视化,分别为100、200、300、400和500个纪元。 没有GCO,预测显示,各个培训时期都存在明显的不稳定性,其特点是损害大小和空间局部化的波动。 就口服样本而言,病变反应出现在早期,但逐渐缩小,从300个到500个。 同样,COVID-19样本显示,在整个培训过程中,损害程度和空间分布都存在不规则变化。

blocks.en: Fig. 11: Activation responses of the proposed local–global decoupling and scale-wise interaction. Compared with the CNN and VSSM branches, the fused branch produces more complete and lesion-aligned activations during decoding, indicating effective integration of local detail and global structure.
blocks.zh: 发相. 11:拟议的地方-全球脱钩和规模互动的激活反应。 与有线电视新闻网和VSSM分支相比,被保险分支在解码过程中产生更完整和与损害相适应的活化,表明本地细节和全球结构的有效融合.

blocks.en: In contrast, incorporating GCO yields more stable prediction evolution. For the Oral sample, the predicted lesion remains consistently localized around the GT region across all epochs, avoiding the abrupt shrinkage observed without GCO. For the COVID-19 sample, the predicted regions maintain more consistent bilateral localization and better preserve the major lesion structures throughout training. These observations suggest that GCO stabilizes the optimization trajectory through gradient-context-aware learning rate adaptation, resulting in more consistent convergence and reliable segmentation predictions.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,纳入GCO则产生更稳定的预测演变. 就口服样本而言,预测的损伤始终在GT区域周围分布,遍及各个时代,避免了在没有GCO的情况下观察到的突然收缩。 就COVID-19样本而言,预测的区域保持了更一致的双边局部化,并在整个培训中更好地保护了主要的损伤结构。 这些观察表明,GCO通过梯度-context-意识-学习速率的适应来稳定优化轨迹,从而产生更一致的趋同和可靠的分化预测.

blocks.en: IV-E Activation Response Analysis
blocks.zh: IV-E 活性反应分析

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 11 , we visualize the activation responses of the CNN branch, the VSSM branch, and the fusion branch at the encoding and decoding stages. The three branches exhibit complementary response patterns. The CNN branch produces strong lesion-related activations in shallow encoding stages ( e.g. , E cnn1 E_{\text{cnn1}} and E cnn2 E_{\text{cnn2}} ) and decoding stages ( e.g. , D cnn1 D_{\text{cnn1}} and D cnn2 D_{\text{cnn2}} ), indicating high sensitivity to local textures, boundary cues, and fine structural variations. However, lesion-background and boundary-adjacent responses are also observed in deeper stages, suggesting susceptibility to local interference.
blocks.zh: 如图11所示,我们可视化CNN分支,VSSM分支,以及编码和解码阶段的聚变分支的激活响应. 这三个分支表现出互补的反应模式。 CNN分支在浅编码阶段(如:Enn1 E_{\text{cnn1}}和Enn2 E_{\text{cnn2}})和解码阶段(如:Dnn1 D_{\text{cnn1}}和Dnn2 D_{\text{cnn2}})产生强烈的与损伤有关的活化作用,表明对当地纹理,边界提示和细微的结构变化高度敏感. 然而,在更深的阶段也观察到了损害背景和相接边界的反应,这表明容易受到当地干扰。

blocks.en: TABLE IV: Computational complexity and inference efficiency under a unified input resolution and hardware setting. Lower values indicate better performance. Best results are highlighted in bold .
blocks.zh: 表格 四:统一输入分辨率和硬件设置下的计算复杂性和推算效率. 数值较低表明业绩较好。 最佳成果以黑体突出。

blocks.en: In contrast, the VSSM branch generates more spatially distributed activations, reflecting its ability to capture broader contextual information. Nevertheless, its responses around lesion regions are occasionally less concentrated, as observed in D vssm1 D_{\text{vssm1}} and D vssm2 D_{\text{vssm2}} , indicating reduced sensitivity to small or localized structures.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,VSSM分支产生更空间分布活化,反映其获取更广阔背景信息的能力. 尽管如此,它围绕病变区域的反应偶尔并不那么集中,如D vssm1 D_{\text{vssm1}}和D vsm2 D_{\text{vssm2}}}所观察到的,表明对小结构或局部结构的敏感性降低.

blocks.en: The fusion branch (see Fig. 2 ) effectively combines these complementary characteristics. Across both the encoding and decoding stages, lesion-related activations are preserved more consistently ( e.g. , E F1 E_{\text{F1}} – E F3 E_{\text{F3}} and D F2 D_{\text{F2}} – D F3 D_{\text{F3}} ), while irrelevant lesion-background responses are progressively suppressed. As a result, the fused features exhibit stronger alignment with the lesion regions, demonstrating that the proposed fusion strategy successfully integrates CNN-based local discriminability with VSSM-based contextual modeling to provide more informative representations for segmentation.
blocks.zh: 聚变分支(见图2)有效地结合了这些互补特征. 在整个编码和解码阶段,与损伤相关的活化功能都得到更一致的保存(例如:E F1 E_{\text{F1}}-EF3 E_{\text{F3}}-和D F2 D_{\text{F2}}-D3 D_{\text{F3}}-),而无关的损伤背景反应则被逐渐压制. 因此,已引信的功能与损伤区域更加一致,表明拟议的聚变战略成功地将基于有线电视新闻网的当地歧视性与基于VSSM的背景模型结合起来,为分化提供更多信息。

blocks.en: IV-F Computational Complexity
blocks.zh: 四-F 计算复杂程度

blocks.en: Table IV compares model complexity and inference efficiency in terms of parameter count, GFLOPs, and per-image latency. A clear trade-off can be observed among existing methods. Lightweight models such as CyCoSeg and UltraLight VM achieve low computational cost, but their limited capacity may constrain performance under heterogeneous imaging conditions. Conversely, high-capacity models, including XNet , GobletNet , and MBP-SSNet , require substantially more parameters or computational operations, indicating that increasing model scale alone does not necessarily yield a more efficient or effective solution.
blocks.zh: 表四从参数计数,GFLOP,和每个成像间隔的角度比较模型复杂性和推论效率. 现有方法之间可以明显取舍。 CyCoSeg和UltraLight VM等轻量级模型实现了较低的计算成本,但其有限的能力可能限制在相异成像条件下的性能. 反之,包括XNet、GobletNet和MBP-SSNet在内的高容量模型需要更多的参数或计算操作,表明单靠模型规模的增加不一定产生更有效率或更有效的解决办法。

blocks.en: O2D-MedNet contains 158.31M parameters, 12.533 GFLOPs, and 37.902 millisecond latency per image. Although the dual-backbone architecture and cross-backbone interactions increase the parameter count and inference latency, the overall computational cost remains competitive, with lower GFLOPs than several high-capacity baselines, including MTG-Net , MBP-SSNet , GobletNet , and XNet . Combined with the quantitative segmentation results, these findings suggest that O2D-MedNet achieves a favorable balance between segmentation performance and computational efficiency, with its gains arising from effective architectural design rather than model scale alone.
blocks.zh: O2D-MedNet包含158.31M参数,12.533GFLOPs,以及37.902毫秒的每个图像等. 虽然双背骨架构和跨背骨互动增加了参数计数和推论延迟性,但总的计算成本仍然具有竞争力,其GFLOP低于几个高容量基线,包括MTG-Net,MBP-SSNet,GobletNet和XNet. 这些结论与定量分解结果相结合,表明O2D-MedNet在分解性能和计算效率之间实现了有利的平衡,其收益来自有效的建筑设计,而不是单靠模型尺度.

blocks.en: IV-G Further Cross-Architecture Validation of GCO
blocks.zh: IV-G 进一步的跨结构 GCO的验证

blocks.en: To evaluate the generalization of GCO beyond O2D-MedNet , we integrate it into six representative segmentation backbones spanning CNN-, Transformer-, and VSSM-based architectures. As shown in Fig. 12 , GCO consistently improves mIoU on both the Oral and COVID-19 datasets across all evaluated models, yielding average gains of 3.2 and 2.1 points, respectively. These consistent improvements suggest that the effectiveness of GCO is not tied to a specific network architecture.
blocks.zh: 为了评估GCO在O2D-MedNet以外的泛化, 我们把它整合到六个具有代表性的分块主干线上, 跨越CNN、变形器和基于VSSM的架构。 如图12所示,GCO在所有评价模型的口服数据集和COVID-19数据集上不断改进MIOU,平均收益分别为3.2分和2.1分。 这些连贯的改进表明,GCO的有效性并不与特定的网络架构挂钩.

blocks.en: Combined with the prediction evolution analysis in Fig. 10 , the results indicate that GCO primarily operates at the optimization level rather than the representation level. By adaptively regulating the learning rate based on gradient-context information, GCO promotes more stable training dynamics and reliable convergence, leading to improved segmentation performance across diverse backbone architectures and heterogeneous medical imaging scenarios.
blocks.zh: 结合图10中的预测演化分析,结果显示GCO主要运行在优化级别而非代表级别. 通过以梯度-背景信息为基础适应性地调节学习率,GCO促进更稳定的培训动态和可靠的趋同,导致不同主干架构和不同医学成像情景的分化性能得到改进.

blocks.en: Fig. 12: Cross-backbone generalization of GCO on the Oral and COVID-19 datasets.
blocks.zh: 发相. 12:口服和COVID-19数据集上GCO的交叉后骨通缩.

blocks.en: V Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 五. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: This paper presents an optimization-aware dual-domain network for robust medical image segmentation ( O2D-MedNet ) under composite degradations and multi-scale geometric variations. The proposed framework is based on the observation that degradation suppression, local-global representation learning, and optimization stability are inherently coupled and should be addressed in a coordinated manner. To this end, O2D-MedNet integrates dual-domain feature refinement, contour-guided cross-backbone interaction, and gradient-context-aware optimization within a unified framework. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets spanning multiple imaging modalities and anatomical targets demonstrate consistent improvements in segmentation accuracy, sensitivity, and topological consistency, highlighting the effectiveness of jointly modeling feature representation and optimization dynamics.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍在复合降解和多尺度几何变异下为强健的医学影像分化(O2D-MedNet)所呈现的优化-意识双域网络. 拟议框架基于以下观点,即遏制退化、地方-全球代表性学习和优化稳定性是内在结合的,应当以协调的方式加以解决。 为此,O2D-MedNet整合了双域特性的完善,轮廓导出跨后骨的相互作用,以及梯度-context-在统一框架内的优化. 对涵盖多成像模式和解剖目标的6个基准数据集进行的广泛实验表明,分解精度、敏感性和地貌一致性持续提高,突出了联合建模特征表现和优化动态的有效性。

blocks.en: Despite these promising results, several limitations remain. The current study is restricted to 2D segmentation tasks, and extending the framework to 3D volumes and temporal imaging data requires further investigation. In addition, resizing inputs to a fixed resolution may compromise extremely fine-grained structures, while the dual-backbone design introduces additional parameters and inference latency compared with lightweight architectures. Although improved topological metrics indicate enhanced structural consistency, further clinical validation is necessary to assess practical utility in real-world settings. Future work will focus on extending the framework to 3D and longitudinal imaging scenarios, improving robustness under limited annotations and cross-center domain shifts, and incorporating uncertainty-aware modeling to further enhance reliability and generalization.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些有希望的结果,但仍存在若干限制。 目前的研究仅限于2D分解任务,将框架扩大到3D卷和时间成像数据需要进一步调查. 此外,对固定分辨率的输入再作大小调整可能会损害极其精细的结构,而双背骨设计则会引入与轻量级建筑相比的额外参数和推论延迟. 虽然地形测量的改进表明结构一致性得到增强,但为了评估现实世界中的实际效用,需要进一步的临床验证。 今后的工作将侧重于将框架扩大到3D和纵向成像情景,在有限说明和跨中心域转移下提高稳健性,并纳入不确定性意识模型,以进一步提高可靠性和通俗性。
